An object of the present invention is to provide a vehicle seat in which a vacant space produced after tipping up a seat cushion can be effectively used as a luggage storage space. The vehicle seat includes: a support leg (6A, 6B, 6C) to support weight related to a seat cushion (2); a leg holding member (8) to hold a lower part (6C) of the support leg (6A, 6B, 6C); and a slide mechanism (18A, 18B) to move the seat cushion (2) and a seat back (3) in a front/back direction. The invention provides a vehicle seat designed to convert the space created beneath the seat cushion when the cushion is tipped upward into a practical luggage-storage area. The seat includes a support leg that bears the load applied to the seat cushion, as well as a leg-holding member that securely retains the lower portion of the support leg.

A slide mechanism enables the seat cushion and seat back to move together in the forward and backward directions. The seat also incorporates a tip-up function that raises the front portion of the seat cushion until the cushion faces the seat back, thereby creating additional storage space. During sliding movement, the leg-holding member moves together with the seat cushion and seat back as part of the slide mechanism, ensuring that the support leg remains properly secured and aligned throughout seat adjustment.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to a vehicle seat designed to provide additional luggage space within the passenger compartment. The seat includes a seat cushion, a seat back, support legs for supporting the seat cushion in its normal seating position, a leg-holding member for retaining the support legs when the cushion is raised, and a slide mechanism that allows the seat to move in the front-to-back direction of the vehicle.

When additional storage space is required, the seat cushion can be tipped upward from its normal, generally horizontal position. Raising the cushion exposes the floor area that was previously occupied by the cushion and its supporting structure, thereby creating a space in which luggage or other articles can be placed. The support legs may be folded or otherwise displaced from their normal supporting positions and retained by the leg-holding member so that they do not project into the newly available storage area.

The slide mechanism includes a fixed portion attached to the vehicle body and a movable portion that travels along the fixed portion. The seat cushion and seat back are supported on the movable portion so that they can be adjusted together in the longitudinal direction of the vehicle. Significantly, the leg-holding member is also mounted on the movable portion of the slide mechanism.

As a result, when the seat is moved forward or rearward, the leg-holding member moves together with the seat cushion and seat back. It therefore does not remain behind in the floor area vacated by the raised cushion. This arrangement prevents the leg-holding member and retained support legs from obstructing the storage space and allows the exposed floor area to be used more effectively for luggage.

The invention thus combines a tip-up cushion arrangement with longitudinal seat adjustment while preserving a clear and practical storage area. It improves space utilization, reduces interference from seat-support components, and enables occupants to convert the seating area into luggage space quickly and conveniently.

### The Power of “The”

“The” is one of the smallest yet most important words in the English language. Known as the definite article, it identifies a specific person, place, object, or idea. Saying “a book” can refer to any book, while “the book” points to one particular book.

Although it often goes unnoticed, “the” brings clarity and precision to communication. It helps readers understand what is already known, unique, or important in a sentence. This simple three-letter word demonstrates how even the most ordinary parts of language can play an essential role.

counterfactuals.output:
**Abstract**

A tip-up vehicle seat is provided in which a seat cushion (2) is selectively retained in a seating position and a tipped-up position. The seat cushion (2) is supported by a seat frame (3) and is movable through link members (6A–6C) between the seating position and the tipped-up position. A locking mechanism (8) restricts movement of the seat cushion (2) in at least the seating position. Engagement portions (18A, 18B) are arranged to guide and retain the seat cushion (2) during the movement thereof. Accordingly, the seat cushion (2) can be tipped up with a simple operation while suppressing rattling and unintended displacement, thereby increasing an available vehicle-compartment space.

counterfactuals.prompt: Explain the object and construction of a vehicle seat invention in which the cushion rotates upward until its seating surface faces the front of the seat back, creating usable cargo space.
counterfactuals.output:
**Object of the invention:**  
To increase a vehicle’s usable cargo area without removing the seat. The seat cushion can be moved out of its normal horizontal position and stored upright against the seat back, exposing the floor space formerly occupied by the cushion. Positioning the upholstered seating surface toward the seat back also protects it from cargo and damage.

**Construction and operation:**  

- The seat includes a generally fixed or separately supported **seat back** and a **seat cushion**.
- The rear portion of the cushion is connected to the vehicle body or seat frame by **transversely aligned pivots or hinge arms**.
- In the normal position, the cushion extends forward horizontally and is held by supports and a releasable latch.
- After the latch is released, the front of the cushion is swung upward about the rear transverse pivot.
- The cushion rotates approximately 90 degrees into an upright position immediately in front of the seat back.
- In this stored position, the cushion’s **seating surface faces rearward toward the front surface of the seat back**, while its underside faces the cargo area.
- A detent, latch, strap, or over-center linkage may retain the cushion upright and prevent unintended movement.
- Folding or retractable support members can move with the cushion so that the floor beneath and in front of the seat is left substantially unobstructed.

The resulting arrangement provides a larger, more continuous cargo space while keeping the seat assembly permanently installed and allowing it to be quickly returned to its passenger-carrying position.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
